name: decompose-task
description: Use when an existing task in an active Piyaz project carries scope larger than 13 points worth of work (composer's research brief raised the `oversize-task` flag, or the user explicitly says "split this task", "decompose RZE-42", "this task is too big", "break <taskRef> into smaller pieces"). Composer dispatches this from its oversize handler. Splits the parent into 2 to N child tasks, rewires every dependency edge touching the parent, and cancels the parent with rationale citing the children. Do NOT use for greenfield project decomposition (route to piyaz:decompose), for adding a new feature to an active project (route to piyaz:decompose-feature), or for refining a task without splitting it (route to the piyaz skill directly).
